title: Lupin Leads — Website
summary: A dark, confident landing site that turns contractors into booked strategy calls.
overview: Lupin Leads runs Meta advertising for contractors. Its website has one job: get a roofer, plumber or renovator to book a free strategy call. We designed and built it around that single action — a clear promise, proof of how the system works and a booking button that's never more than a scroll away.

cover.alt: Lupin Leads homepage: the headline Less Guesswork. beside a dashboard showing a captured lead and a sample executive report

idea.heading: The idea
body: Contractors don't want marketing jargon; they want to see the lead come in. The hero pairs a blunt headline — "Less Guesswork." — with an interface preview of a lead arriving in the pipeline and a sample monthly report, so the product is shown, not described.
Every section answers a contractor's next question in order: how it works, which trades it's for, what it costs and what happens on the call.

execution.heading: What we built
body: Brand-matched design in black, deep green and Lupin purple; responsive build tuned for phones; copywriting and page structure; booking calls-to-action throughout; SEO metadata and social sharing images.
